item.title: Social Circle Redskins revitalize state playoff goals in region tournament
item.description: Both Social Circle basketball teams started playing their best basketball when it’s most desired — tournament season.

item.title: Lady Rams advance to region title while Newton boys fall to South Gwinnett
item.description: The semifinals for Region 4-AAAAAA took center stage at South Gwinnett High School on Thursday, but the Newton Rams left with mixed results. Newton’s boys team started the day with a crushing defeat to the hosting Comets while the Lady Rams took down a scrappy Grovetown team.

item.title: Josh Brown Jr. no-hits Tucker as Newton earns commanding 14-0 win
item.description: The moment Josh Brown Jr. took the mound for Thursday’s battle between Tucker and Newton, the Tigers found themselves outmatched at the plate.Brown’s four innings of work were the catalyst for Newton’s 14-0 win that saw Tucker tally zero hits and only two walks.

item.title: Social Circle Redskins win third straight with 14-1 victory over Alcovy Tigers
item.description: Social Circle stayed in its winning ways on Wednesday as it defeated cross-county rival Alcovy 14-1.The game went a full five innings, and it showcased a dominant pitching performance from the Redskins staff.It was not just one starter. In fact, five different Social Circle pitchers each pitched one inning on their way to a one-hit performance.

item.title: IRWIN: A Journeyman’s Note of Gratitude
item.description: A few years ago, I was on a sentimental journey at the home of my dearest old friend, Ron Balthazor. Ron and his wife, Jane Hudson, are gentleman/gentlewoman farmers who dwell in darkest Oconee County, Georgia. Being old camp counselors, Ron and I were sharing an outdoor fire with his dogs, Oak the Great Pyrenees and Zen the twelve-week-old Pyrenees, who at thirty-five pounds had yet to reach greatness.

item.title: LETTER: Concerns about the ICE facility
item.description: Dear Editor. Yesterday, I drove past the warehouse that ICE just bought for 128 million dollars in Social Circle, GA. It is about ten miles from my house on the way to the city of Monroe where I have a store in an antique mall. Social Circle is a town of 5,000 people who didn’t want it, but got it anyway. item.title: No fender, no problem: Tyler Reddick wins the Autotrader 400, goes back-to-back
item.description: It took 10 cautions, two overtimes and thousands of left turns in 40-degree weather. But in the end, it was 23XI’s racing Tyler Reddick who prevailed at Sunday’s Autotrader 400 at EchoPark Speedway.
